notes: v1.28: Latest Python (3.15) support, no interpreter mismatch. The app code uses no Python 3.15 removed API, so the 'installed latest Python, now it crashes' failure is an interpreter mismatch: a new Python is a fresh environment with no openpyxl, and the old scripts did not list Python 3.15, while Debug/Safe used bare python (PATH order, usually newest) and the icon used a 312-first order. Fixed in the .bat files only: Setup.bat and the launcher now list Python315 in the same 312/313/314/315 order (user, Program Files, C: locations), so a PC with only 3.15 is found explicitly and Setup installs openpyxl for it; Debug and Safe bats now use that same finder and print the Python version first. On the client PC: extract v1.28, run its Setup.bat once, then use the desktop icon.
